fact: Cameroon's National Institute of Statistics (INS) officially launched the Open SDG platform on 17 September 2025 to give the public access to data on the Sustainable Development Goals, set up in 2024 with UNECA support; the document does not state a dataset count or a licence.

INS Cameroun reports that at the Littoral region's African Statistics Day an INS officer presented its data platforms, the Portail Open Data, Open SDG and ANADOC, for making national statistics accessible.

Cameroon's national statistics institute (INS) unveiled on 22 April 2026 platforms giving direct access to macroeconomic series and, through a national data archive, survey microdata, with no licence stated.
